ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) boundaries at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field centrally. Continuous dark pigment band along the trailing edge, increasing in thickness at the tips. Discrete dark focal spots are visible in the inner-left lobe and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped indentation with a deep vertical profile and an approximate 90-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with irregular, low-amplitude peaks and valleys, most pronounced along the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips, terminating in sharp, caudally-directed points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark pixel clusters at both fluke tips; individual dark circular mottling spots scattered across the white ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark pigmentation and textural roughing at the distal tips, likely resulting from barnacle colonization or localized trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, discrete dark spots located in a vertical alignment near the median notch just above the water line.
